SELECT seq_review.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO review ( review_no, member_no, product_no, order_item_no, title, content, rating, user_height, user_weight, size_rating, image_url, like_count, created_at, delete_yn ) VALUES ( #{reviewNo}, #{memberNo}, #{productNo}, #{orderItemNo}, #{title}, #{content}, #{rating}, #{userHeight}, #{userWeight}, #{sizeRating}, #{imageUrl}, 0, SYSTIMESTAMP, 'N' )
mapper.select: SELECT review_no, member_no, product_no, order_item_no, title, content, rating, user_height, user_weight, size_rating, image_url, like_count, created_at, updated_at, delete_yn FROM review WHERE product_no = #{productNo} AND delete_yn = 'N' ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT review_no, member_no, product_no, order_item_no, title, content, rating, user_height, user_weight, size_rating, image_url, like_count, created_at, updated_at, delete_yn FROM review WHERE review_no = #{reviewNo}
SELECT review_no, order_item_no, product_no FROM review WHERE order_item_no = #{orderItemNo} AND delete_yn = 'N'

SELECT r.review_no AS reviewNo, r.product_no AS productNo, oi.item_name AS itemName, r.content AS content, r.rating AS rating, r.created_at AS createdAt, o.order_no AS orderNo, r.image_url AS imageUrl,
pi.image_url AS productMainImage
FROM review r INNER JOIN order_item oi ON r.order_item_no = oi.order_item_no INNER JOIN orders o ON oi.order_no = o.order_no INNER JOIN product p ON r.product_no = p.product_no
LEFT JOIN product_img pi ON p.product_no = pi.product_no AND pi.image_type = 'THUMB' -- (또는 'MAIN' 등 대표 이미지 타입)
WHERE r.member_no = #{memberNo} AND r.delete_yn = 'N' ORDER BY r.created_at DESC

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT r.review_no AS reviewNo, m.nick_name AS memberNickName, p.name AS productName, r.rating AS rating, r.content AS content, r.created_at AS createdAt FROM review r INNER JOIN member m ON r.member_no = m.member_no INNER JOIN product p ON r.product_no = p.product_no WHERE r.delete_yn = 'N' ORDER BY r.created_at DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= 6
mapper.update: UPDATE review SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, rating = #{rating}, user_height = #{userHeight}, user_weight = #{userWeight}, size_rating = #{sizeRating}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, updated_at = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE review_no = #{reviewNo}
